channel.title: Music Business Worldwide (MBW) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music Business Worldwide (MBW) (musicbusinessworldwide.com)

item.title: HYBE AMERICA launches Blue Highway Records in Nashville, names Jake Basden as CEO
item.description: HYBE AMERICA's Nashville-based country, Americana and roots rock division rebrands as Blue Highway Records, effective immediately Source

item.title: Deezer launches ‘Flow Tuner’ to give users more control over algorithmic playlists
item.description: Flow Tuner adjusts recommendations in real time instead of relying on likes, dislikes or skips. Source

item.title: US state attorneys general ready to take Live Nation to trial, with or without DoJ (report)
item.description: State attorneys general plan to meet later this week to discuss the case without federal government participation, Bloomberg reported. Source

item.title: Rebecca Dixon promoted to Global Head of Marketing & Strategy at Various Artists amid raft of senior appointments at firm’s UK HQ
item.description: George Shepherd has also been promoted to Associate Director Source

item.title: Universal Music strikes deal with superfan platform EVEN to power D2C sales for artists worldwide
item.description: The deal arrives just weeks after UMG acquired a minority stake in superfan platform Stationhead. Source

item.title: AI remix startup Hook secures $10m in Series A led by Khosla Ventures
item.description: The startup promoted Simmi Singh to Chief Operating Officer & Chief Product Officer. Source

item.title: Taylor Swift was IFPI’s biggest-selling recording artist globally in 2025 – for a record sixth time
item.description: Swift has now won the award as many times as all other artists combined over the past 10 years. Source

item.title: Concord opens new Los Angeles office on Wilshire Boulevard in Beverly Hills
item.description: 'This new office signals the future of Concord,' said CEO Bob Valentine Source

item.title: Google just launched Lyria 3 – its ‘most advanced’ AI music generator yet – in the Gemini app
item.description: Lyria 3 lets Gemini users create 30-second tracks from text prompts or images Source

item.title: Spotify says it has ‘helped artists generate’ $1bn+ in ticket sales to date. Now it’s teaming up with SeatGeek to drive even more
item.description: SeatGeek becomes the latest ticketing platform to join Spotify's growing live events ecosystem. Source
